Clean up orphan __drt_swap shadow tables left by interrupted swaps.

Use --orphans to list candidate shadow tables and --execute to drop them.

## Usage

```bash
drt clean [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--orphans` | `BOOLEAN` |  | List or drop orphan __drt_swap tables. |
| `--execute` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Execute drops (default: dry-run). |
| `--config`, `-c` | `TEXT` | `drt.yml` | Path to config file. |
